title: Image to Video AI for Product Ads | AIVideosUGC
description: Animate one product photo into a short video ad for TikTok, Reels, or product pages. Add clear movement without booking a new shoot or camera crew.
h1: AI Image to Video: Move a Product Photo Into an Ad
lead: AIVideosUGC adds one clear motion to a product photo you already have, such as a pour, a turn, an open or a stretch. No camera crew and no new shoot. Pick a size, choose 6 to 30 seconds and download a clip for a feed, a listing or a product page.
benefits_h2: Turn an Image Into a Video Ad You Can Test

benefits.d: Go from a still to a moving clip without booking a camera. Change the first movement and render another version.
A 6-second clip uses 24 credits and a 15-second clip uses 60. If the render fails, those credits come back.

benefits.t: Check the Item Before You Post
benefits.d: Compare the finished motion with the source photo. If the shape, color or label drifts, render again before you post.
Show a pump press, a stretch or an open in the first seconds, so the detail is visible before the viewer moves on.
You decide what moves and how long it runs. Sound, captions and price are added after download.
Finished clips can run in paid or organic placements, and they carry no watermark.

steps_h2: How to Make an Image-to-Video Ad in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Upload one clear product image, name one motion and download the clip.

steps.d: Upload one clear photo with the full item visible. The motion is applied to this image.
Name one movement, such as a turn, pour, open or stretch, then pick a size and a length from 6 to 30 seconds.
Download the clip when it is ready. Add captions, a price or licensed music in your editor, then post it.

faq.q: What is AI image to video?
faq.a: It adds one focused motion to a still product photo, such as a turn, a pour, an open or a stretch.

faq.q: How do I turn a product photo into a video?
faq.a: Upload a clear photo, name one motion, pick a size and a length, then download the clip.

faq.q: Does image to video write a script or add audio?
faq.a: No. The tool only animates the photo. Add a script, narration, music or captions in your editor after download.
Use a clear, well-lit photo with the full product visible and the important details in frame.

faq.q: How many credits does a clip use?
faq.a: 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15 and 120 for 30. A failed job returns its credits.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Change the motion, the size or the length and keep the same photo.

faq.q: Where can I use the clip?
faq.a: In a TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or product listing, after you check that channel's current rules.

faq.q: What if the motion looks wrong?
faq.a: Describe a simpler motion and generate again. Compare the product with the source photo before you post.

faq.q: Can I use the clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Finished clips can be used commercially and they have no watermark.

definition.title: What Is AI Image to Video?
paras: AI image to video adds movement to a still product photo. Shoppers see one action, such as a lid lifting, liquid pouring or fabric stretching, instead of a frozen frame.
AIVideosUGC keeps the item from your upload. It does not write a script and it does not add sound. Put captions, a price or licensed music on the file in your editor after download.

Change the motion or the length and compare openings while the product photo stays put.
